name: Ese Len
source:
"Divine Swords sure are amazing. I wonder if they can make your breasts bigger?"

Your average student. 140 cm tall with a small frame.
Certain circumstances brought her into possession of a Divine Sword, granting her abilities far beyond what any regular human can achieve.

Reuniting with her childhood friend [url=/c39165]Shinonome[/url] leads to her very idea of normality being crushed without remorse.

While healthy as one can be under normal circumstances, she has a habit of throwing up over the slightest of things.

She was born with the particular ability to "see" people's presence.

[From the official [url=https://www.indiegogo.com/projects/ne-no-kami-a-yuri-vn-of-demons-spirits-and-love#/]IndieGoGo page[/url]]
